title: chore(client): preserve headstock suite views out of src (MAINT-DEFER-010)
intent: Owner ruling 2026-10-13: the four views in packages/client/src/views/cam/headstock/ are work to preserve, not debris. The lineage reconciliation (PR #437) shows they are the final iterations of the headstock half of the 2026-03-17 ps-vue suite, with capability the routed /art-studio/headstock lacks. They are uncompilable in src/ because 5 supporting modules are lost, and they accounted for 63 of the 150 tolerated vue-tsc errors. Move them, byte-identical, to a documented archive location outside vue-tsc's src/** include. Do not delete them.
behavior_change: None at runtime. The views had zero inbound imports and no route, so vite build never included them; the shipped bundle is unchanged. The four files move by pure git rename (similarity 100%) to archive/experimental/2026-03/headstock-suite-refined/. Blobs are unchanged: ConfiguratorView 4c3ac93b, ImportView 674d3fde, ParametricView 755e25e6, WorkspaceView 3be10a9e. A README there records provenance, where each import resolves, and folder rules. SPRINTS.md MAINT-DEFER-010 is updated to QUEUED — PRESERVED (documented enum token qualified, with the ruling marked as a reported owner statement that the owner's merge authenticates) with the two corrections (not dead code; #308 never reached main), and the original finding text is kept. The vue-tsc error count falls below the 150 ceiling (see verification). The ceiling and scripts/ci/client_type_check_baseline.json are deliberately NOT changed here: lowering the ceiling is a separate follow-up after this preservation merges, per the agreed order.

diff_articulation.what_changed: git mv of four .vue files from packages/client/src/views/cam/headstock/ to archive/experimental/2026-03/headstock-suite-refined/, plus a README in that folder and a SPRINTS.md ledger update.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: PR #308 attempted deletion, but it never reached main (stranded stacked merge), and the owner has since ruled for preservation. This is the first change that takes the views out of compilation while keeping them.
